description: Run spell check and optionally grammar check. Spell check (en-US/en-GB) is free and offline. Grammar with Gemini is free (BYOK). Multi-language and OpenAI/Anthropic require LexiLint Premium.

api_key.description: Optional per-call API key override; otherwise uses the selected provider environment variable

language.description: Language code. Free: en-US, en-GB. Premium: fr, de, es, ru, pl, tr.

license_key.description: LexiLint Premium license key (for premium languages or providers)

model.description: Optional provider model ID. Custom models require LexiLint Premium.

provider.description: AI provider. "gemini" is free. "openai"/"anthropic" require Premium.

name: check_text
